_meta.scope: Recurring annual events within ~45 min drive of the property — Pickens, Gilmer, Fannin, Lumpkin counties. Manually curated; not a live feed (see CLAUDE.md for the feed-availability scoping that justified this).
_meta.refreshCadence: Annual review each January; spot-check 30 days before each event.

schema.name: Event display name.
schema.location: Specific venue or street, including town.
schema.driveMin: Approx drive time from the property, in minutes. Update if route changes.
schema.dates: Specific date or YYYY-MM-DD..YYYY-MM-DD range for the next confirmed occurrence. Null if the next year's dates aren't yet posted.
schema.pattern: Human-readable recurrence rule (e.g., 'First weekend of October'). Used to render fallback text when dates is null.
schema.type: Tags — festival | market | music | food | outdoor | history | family | holiday | rodeo | art
schema.url: Primary URL for the event (official site preferred over aggregator).
schema.notes: 1-2 sentences in field-journal voice. What this event actually is, plus any property-anchored connection.

events.name: Georgia Marble Festival
events.location: Lee Newton Park, 500 Veterans Memorial Blvd, Jasper
events.notes: 44th annual in 2026. About 120 exhibitors, 9,000 attendees. Quarry tours, marble-sculpting and chainsaw-carving demos, 5K and parade. The closest thing Pickens County has to a hometown festival — directly anchored in the marble heritage that explains why Tate exists at all.

events.name: Talking Rock Heritage Days
events.location: Town of Talking Rock (along Talking Rock Creek)
events.notes: Two-day arts/crafts/music festival in the tiny incorporated town of Talking Rock, on the banks of the creek that the Cherokee called Nunyu-gunwaniski. Free admission and parking. Pair with a stop at the Hwy 136 bridge — the old Federal Road's Talking Rock Ford crossing.

events.name: Sheriff's JeepFest
events.notes: Three-day Jeep festival: trails, obstacles, mud, concerts, food. Spectators free. Benefits Georgia Sheriffs' Youth Homes, Pickens Special Olympics, Boys & Girls Club, Jasper Youth Sports.

events.name: Jasper Pro Rodeo (Pickens County Stampede)
events.notes: Annual PRCA rodeo. Single-evening attendance option.

events.name: Georgia Apple Festival
events.pattern: Second and third weekends of October
events.notes: Largest annual event in Gilmer County. Hundreds of vendors, on-site demos, live music, fair food. $10 admission, kids under 12 free. Note the two-weekend schedule — Oct 10-11 AND Oct 17-18 in 2026.

events.name: Georgia Apple Festival — Weekend 2
events.pattern: Third weekend of October (second of two Apple Festival weekends)
events.notes: Second weekend of the Apple Festival run.

events.name: Ellijay Farmers & Artisans Market
events.pattern: Saturdays, 8:30 AM – 12:30 PM, May through September
events.notes: 50+ vendors weekly through the growing season. Recurring — render as a weekly chip when active, not a single-date callout.

events.name: Blue Ridge Trout & Outdoor Adventures Festival
events.notes: Cast, bike, paddle, hike, fish, climb, ride — plus live music, craft beer, outdoor art. Honors the trout streams of Fannin County.

events.name: Spring Arts in the Park (Blue Ridge)
events.notes: 200+ juried fine arts exhibitors plus crafts, food, artist demos. The bigger of Blue Ridge's two Arts in the Park weekends.

events.name: Fall Arts in the Park (Blue Ridge)
events.notes: Fall counterpart to Spring Arts in the Park. Conflicts with Apple Festival weekend 1 — pick one or split the day.

events.name: Blue Ridge Blues & BBQ Festival
events.notes: 15th annual in 2026. 11:30 AM – 9 PM. 15+ BBQ pitmasters, blues acts, local vendors.

events.name: Blue Ridge St. Patrick's Day Parade
events.notes: Small-town St. Patrick's parade with local businesses and community groups.

events.name: Fire and Ice Chili Cook-Off (Blue Ridge)
events.notes: Winter chili festival with ice sculptures. One of the few mid-winter local festivals worth the drive.

events.name: Bear on the Square Mountain Festival
events.notes: 28th annual in 2026. Friday ticketed concert (Lonesome River Band, 2026); Saturday and Sunday free. Juried mountain crafts, storytelling, music workshops, Sunday Gospel Jam. The marquee Appalachian-tradition festival in the area.

events.name: Dahlonega Arts & Wine Festival
events.notes: Wine from area wineries plus arts, crafts, live jazz. Dahlonega is Georgia's wine country anchor.

events.name: Gold Rush Days (Dahlonega)
events.notes: Commemorates Georgia's 1828 gold rush (Dahlonega, not the famous 1849 California one). Crafts, panning demonstrations, parade.

events.name: Light Up Ellijay
events.notes: Tree lighting, Santa, parade, live entertainment, seasonal vendors. The local holiday-season opener.

events.name: Holiday Lights of Ellijay
events.notes: Drive-through light display with light maze and Santa visits. Multi-week run.
